f3_program: collection("olaf.toy_cars", "toy_car", "olaf", source("Olaf collects colorful toy cars"))
observe(at("olaf.toy_cars.count", "initial"), 150, "count", source("At first, his collection consisted of 150 cars"))
add("grandpa_gift", "grandpa", at("olaf.toy_cars.count", "current"), "olaf.gifts.grandpa.toy_cars.count", source("Grandpa gave Olaf twice as many toy cars as the uncle"))
add("uncle_gift", "uncle", at("olaf.toy_cars.count", "current"), "olaf.gifts.uncle.toy_cars.count", source("Grandpa gave Olaf twice as many toy cars as the uncle"))
multiple(event_field("grandpa_gift", "quantity"), event_field("uncle_gift", "quantity"), 2, source("Grandpa gave Olaf twice as many toy cars as the uncle"))
add("dad_gift", "dad", at("olaf.toy_cars.count", "current"), 10, source("Dad gave Olaf 10 toy cars"))
add("mum_gift", "mum", at("olaf.toy_cars.count", "current"), "olaf.gifts.mum.toy_cars.count", source("Dad gave Olaf 10 toy cars, 5 less than Mum"))
offset(event_field("dad_gift", "quantity"), event_field("mum_gift", "quantity"), -5, "count", source("Dad gave Olaf 10 toy cars, 5 less than Mum"))
add("auntie_gift", "auntie", at("olaf.toy_cars.count", "current"), 6, source("Auntie gave Olaf 6 toy cars"))
offset(event_field("auntie_gift", "quantity"), event_field("uncle_gift", "quantity"), 1, "count", source("Auntie gave Olaf 6 toy cars, 1 more than the uncle"))
query("value", at("olaf.toy_cars.count", "current"))
assumptions: The comparative gift clauses imply that the uncle and Mum also gave Olaf toy cars.

f3_program: collection("farmer.corn_bags", "corn_bag", "small_farm", source("10 bags of corn"))
remove("corn_seed_purchase", "farmer", at("farmer.money.dollars", "current"), 50, source("spent $50 on corn seeds"))
remove("farm_supplies_purchase", "farmer", at("farmer.money.dollars", "current"), 35, source("$35 on fertilizers and pesticides"))
remove("labor_payment", "farmer", at("farmer.money.dollars", "current"), 15, source("$15 on labor"))
produce("corn_harvest", "farmer", at("farmer.corn_bags.count", "current"), 10, source("he was able to gather 10 bags of corn"))
observe(at("farmer.corn_sales.target_profit_percentage", "current"), 10, "percent", source("make a profit of 10%"))
query("value", "farmer.corn_bag.sale_price")
assumptions: The stated profit percentage is measured relative to the farmer's total cultivation cost, and the harvested bags are to have a common sale price.

f3_program: observe(at("men.added_sugar.recommended_maximum", "per_day"), 150, "calorie", source("men should consume no more than 150 calories of added sugar per day"))
observe(at("mark.soft_drink.calories.total", "afternoon"), 2500, "calorie", source("contained 2500 calories"))
percent_of(at("mark.soft_drink.added_sugar.calories", "afternoon"), at("mark.soft_drink.calories.total", "afternoon"), 5, source("5% of which was from added sugar"))

add("soft_drink_intake", "mark", at("mark.added_sugar.calories", "current"), at("mark.soft_drink.added_sugar.calories", "afternoon"), source("Mark took a soft drink in the afternoon that contained 2500 calories, 5% of which was from added sugar"))
collection("mark.candy_bars", "candy_bar", "mark", source("some bars of candy"))
add("candy_purchase", "mark", at("mark.candy_bars.count", "current"), "mark.candy_bars.purchased.count", source("he bought some bars of candy"))

add("candy_added_sugar_intake", "mark", at("mark.added_sugar.calories", "current"), scale(event_field("candy_purchase", "quantity"), 25), source("Then he bought some bars of candy which had 25 calories of added sugar each"))
percent_more(at("mark.added_sugar.calories", "current"), at("men.added_sugar.recommended_maximum", "per_day"), 100, source("eventually exceeded the recommended intake of added sugar by 100%"))
query("value", event_field("candy_purchase", "quantity"))
assumptions: The candy bars Mark bought are the bars later described as the bars he took, and their added sugar contributes to the stated eventual intake.

f3_program: observe(at("tree.height", "2017"), 100, "meter", source("100 meters tall at the end of 2017"))
percent_more(at("tree.height", "2018"), at("tree.height", "2017"), 10, source("It will grow 10% more than its previous height each year"))
percent_more(at("tree.height", "2019"), at("tree.height", "2018"), 10, source("It will grow 10% more than its previous height each year"))
query("difference", at("tree.height", "2017"), at("tree.height", "2019"))
assumptions: “How long has the tree grown” asks for the increase in height, and the annual statement means each year's height is 10% greater than the preceding year's height.

f3_program: observe(at("paul.earnings.rate", "current"), 12.5, "dollar_per_hour", source("Paul earns $12.50 for each hour that he works"))
observe(at("paul.work.duration", "pay_period"), 40, "hour", source("working 40 hours"))
rate_relation("paul.paycheck.gross", at("paul.earnings.rate", "current"), at("paul.work.duration", "pay_period"), source("Paul earns $12.50 for each hour that he works"))
add("paycheck_receipt", "paul", at("paul.paycheck.balance", "current"), "paul.paycheck.gross", source("Paul receives his paycheck"))
remove("taxes_and_fees_payment", "paul", at("paul.paycheck.balance", "current"), fraction(event_field("paycheck_receipt", "quantity"), 20, 100), source("pay 20% for taxes and fees"))
remove("gummy_bear_purchase", "paul", at("paul.paycheck.balance", "current"), fraction(at("paul.paycheck.balance", "current"), 15, 100), source("he spends 15% of his paycheck on gummy bears"))
query("value", at("paul.paycheck.balance", "current"))
assumptions: Taxes and fees are deducted from gross earnings before the gummy-bear purchase, and “his paycheck” in the spending clause denotes the post-tax paycheck balance.
